note_en: 地 (de) links a description to the verb that follows, like the English -ly ending: 全神贯注地听讲 "listened with full concentration," 冷静地分析 "calmly analyzed." It sounds exactly like 的, but 的 links a description to a noun (我的书), while 地 links a manner word to a verb. This text uses it constantly, even after four-character idioms: 废寝忘食地复习.
